                         POLICY AND PROCEDURE NOTICE #3/00




      TO:           Distribution

      FROM:         Satish K. Babbar, R.A.

      DATE:         July 26, 2000

      SUBJECT:      Application Type Required for Work Involving Demolition in a
                    Building



      Effective:          Immediately

      Purpose:            To establish a procedure to determine the type of
                          application that must be filed for work involving
                          demolition of exterior building walls.

      Supersedes:         Departmental Memorandum, dated March 6, 1986
                          regarding "Determination For Applications To Be Used:
                          New Buildings — C26-110.0; Alterations — C26-111.0;
                          Demolitions - 026-113.0"

      Specifics:          A.       Exterior Walls

                          For the purpose of this TPPN, an exterior wall shall be any
                          building enclosing wall other than a party wall.



ONLY FOR Application Types Required

1




                 A New Building Application shall be filed for a permit as
                 per Article 11 of Subchapter 1 of the Building Code where,

                       during construction: a) an existing building is
                       completely demolished to grade or b) where, during
                       construction, more than 50% of the area of exterior
                       walls of such building are removed and any portion of
                       the foundation system is altered or enlarged.

                       For all New Building Applications where the
                       existing structure is to be demolished, a Demolition
                       Application shall be required for a permit as per
                       Article 14 of Subchapter 1 of the Building Code.
                       This application will require a pre-demolition
                       inspection by the Department and a showing of
                       compliance with §27-169, Notice to adjoining
                       owners and § 27-171, Requirement of photographs.
                       Any request for reconsideration to waive any of
                       the requirements must be directed in writing to the
                       respective Borough Commissioner.

                 An Alteration Application shall be required for a permit as
                 per Article 12 of Subchapter 1 of the Building Code for
                 an existing building not required to be filed under a New
                 Building Application.

                       Prior to the issuance of a permit for any Alteration
                       Application where more than 50% of the area of
                       exterior walls is being removed, or where, as
                       determined by the applicant, the stability of the
                       adjoining building may be affected by the proposed
                       demolition or removal work, only a pre-demolition
                       inspection by the Department shall be required,
                       along with compliance with §27-169, Notice to
                       adjoining owners and §27-171, Requirement of
                       photographs. Where structural stability of the
                       adjoining building(s) will not be affected as
                       determined by the applicant, he must clearly state
                       so on the submitted drawings.

                       Separate demolition plans clearly delineating all
                       removal work shall be provided for alteration
                       applications, where more than 50% of the area of
                       exterior walls is being removed. Plans for
                       applications where 50% or less area of exterior

                        conditions to remain, existing conditions to be
                        removed and proposed new work. The plans shall
                        identify which structural elements need temporary
                        supports and/or bracing. The professional
                        responsible for temporary bracing shall provide
                        necessary details. The Registered Architect/
                        Professional Engineer who is the applicant of
                        record must make a signed statement on the plans
                        submitted that the demolition work does not
                        exceed 50% of the area of exterior walls.

                        Structural stability must be identified as a
                        controlled inspection item on the TR-1 form.

                        Any demolition or construction work deviating from
                        approved plans must be approved prior to
                        proceeding, showing full compliance with the
                        above criteria.

                  Professionally Certified applications shall also strictly
                  adhere to all these requirements.    The pre-demolition
                  inspection however must be done prior to filing the
                  application, when required, and the inspection report
                  must be included with the professionally certified
                  application. Any non-compliance to the above shall be
                  referred to the office of Investigation, Audits and
                  Discipline.

          Plan Examiner

          Prior to the issuance of a permit for any Alteration Application
          where the building is being demolished or where 50% or more
          of the area of exterior walls is being removed, or where the
          adjoining building may be affected by the proposed demolition,
          a pre-demolition inspection by the Department shall be required.
          A copy of the inspection report shall be included in the
          application folder, along with compliance of §27-169, Notice to
          Adjoining Owners and § 27-171, Requirement of Photographs.

          Clerk

          When required, the pre-demolition inspection must be completed
          along with notice to adjoining owners and submission of
          photographs, prior to issuance of any permit for the application.

                 Inspector

                 After the start of construction, if an inspection of the work
                 reveals more demolition than indicated on the approved plans,
                 the work shall be immediately stopped by a stop work order.

                 Borough Commissioner

                 If a stop work order is given for the above, an engineer's survey
                 and report shall be required from the applicant/owner explaining
                 the additional work for the Borough Commissioner's review and
                 determination before any work can be permitted to resume. The
                 application shall be referred to the office of Investigation, Audits
                 and Discipline, if deemed appropriate.
